candidates.detail: The mesh builder emits near-tier seed heads for retained blades of species with a positive branch count when the deterministic panicle draw is below 0.125. Its stem quads use start/end positions with positive and negative lateral offsets, but append_attached_quad gives all four vertices the same U attachment height and negative V attachment fraction, the same normal, color and blade root. The instanced shader clamps negative V to zero and treats U as a binary ribbon-side selector; it computes lateral width from the length of the position offset from the root. It does not take the rigid seed-head branch present in the separate foliage shader.
candidates.geometry_case: For a visible stem edge with the two source positions root minus s and root plus s at the same height, common U/V, normal, color and root, the ideal radial distances from the root are both |s|. The instanced shader therefore gives both vertices the same sign, width, center and side direction. Its curve profile is zero because V is negative. In exact arithmetic the paired edge projects to one vertex; the two stem quad triangles become degenerate when both edges have this symmetry. Actual CPU/GPU f32 rounding can leave small nonzero differences, and no shader or rasterization was executed. This is an illustrative source-derived contract failure, not an observed screenshot or measured visibility claim.
candidates.producer_and_selection: The current playable scene path groups placed tufts by tier and species and skips empty batches; spawn_tuft_batches builds grass_tuft_mesh for each nonempty batch and attaches the instanced grass material, whose shader reference selects tactical_grass_instanced.wgsl through the chunk pipeline. The mesh has position, normal, UV0, UV1 and color attributes. Lock-checksum-bound bevy_pbr source maps UV1 and color layout attributes to the shader definitions and locations used by the chunk Vertex structure. The checked-in graphics file enables grass and configures Near; four species have nonzero branch counts. The condition still requires an actual placed visible near instance, a retained blade and a panicle draw satisfying the producer gates. No particular scene seed or successful rendering is established.
candidates.safeguards: RedFescue and YorkshireFog have zero seed-head branch counts; other tiers do not emit these seed heads. Empty batches are skipped and ground coverage can collapse a blade deliberately. The separate foliage path recognizes negative V and deforms rigid attachments, but no policy requires preserving an obsolete renderer byte for byte. The encoded U=0.5 tip also has a separate radial-width question, which remains a related observation rather than a second unique failure.
